d: Long, straight orchid-purple hair is styled with a high ponytail and long bangs framing the face, paired with large, expressive reddish-brown eyes. The face appears that of a mature teenager with a slender build. The outfit consists of a white short-sleeved collared shirt under a dark charcoal grey sleeveless vest, accented by a bright red ribbon bow at the neck and a matching dark charcoal grey pleated mini-skirt. Signature details include white gloves and heavy grey mechanical naval artillery rigging attached to the back and sides.
